nodes.label: Investment objective
nodes.description: The fund's stated investment goal, such as long-term capital growth, current income, or tracking an index, usually in one or two sentences; how the fund pursues that goal belongs to principal_investment_strategies.

nodes.label: Fees and expenses
nodes.description: The costs of buying, holding, and selling fund shares: shareholder fees and sales charges, annual operating expenses and expense ratios, fee waivers, the expense example, and portfolio turnover.
examples: Fees and Expenses of the Fund

nodes.label: Principal investment strategies
nodes.description: How the fund pursues its objective: the kinds of securities it buys, its selection process or index methodology, and limits on what it may hold; not the risks of those investments (principal_risks) or the portfolio held on a given date (holdings_and_allocation).
examples: Principal Investment Strategies of the Fund

nodes.label: Principal risks
nodes.description: The main risks of investing in the fund or in the offered securities and how they could cause an investor to lose money, such as market, credit, interest-rate, liquidity, and issuer risks; not the strategy that gives rise to them (principal_investment_strategies).
examples: Principal Risks of Investing in the Fund

nodes.label: Performance
nodes.description: Past returns of the fund or share class and its benchmark: annual return bar charts, average annual total return tables, best and worst quarters, the growth of a hypothetical investment, and commentary on past results; not the fund's costs (fees_and_expenses).

nodes.label: Holdings and allocation
nodes.description: What the fund holds as of a date: its top or full holdings, the number of holdings, and breakdowns by asset class, sector, region, credit quality, or maturity; not the strategy that selects them (principal_investment_strategies).

nodes.label: Management
nodes.description: Who runs the fund: the investment adviser and any sub-advisers, the portfolio managers with their tenure and experience, and the management company; the fees paid to them belong to fees_and_expenses.

nodes.label: Purchase and sale
nodes.description: How investors buy, sell, exchange, or redeem shares: minimum investments, available share classes, how orders are placed and priced, and exchange trading; the charges on those transactions belong to fees_and_expenses.
examples: Purchase and Sale of Fund Shares

nodes.label: Tax information
nodes.description: How the fund's distributions and the sale of its shares are taxed, together with its dividend and capital gain distribution policy.

nodes.label: Other
nodes.description: Content that fits none of the other categories, such as cover pages, tables of contents, key fund facts (tickers, inception date, net assets), glossaries, payments to financial intermediaries, service providers, and legal notices.
examples: Payments to Broker-Dealers and Other Financial Intermediaries
